therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: cediranib maleate with or without gefitinib
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: VEGFR inhibition (anti-angiogenic) combined with EGFR inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor angiogenesis and EGFR-driven tumor cell proliferation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with recurrent or progressive glioblastoma

results.effect_size: median PFS: cediranib + gefitinib 3.6 months (95% CI: 2.8-4.1) vs cediranib + placebo 2.8 months (95% CI: 2.1-3.4)
